Proposition
[the star interior is open] Source: petersen:page-0235 ↗ lem:pet-ch5-cut-locus-characterization ↗ lem:pet-ch5-exp-nonsingular-segment-domain

1. ch5:5.7.10

$\operatorname {seg}^0(p)$ is open in $T_pM$.

Formalization status. Not formalized, and genuinely blocked; see subsection 7.3.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch5-segment-domain-open \sketch By subsection 7.3, choose a neighborhood $V$ of $v\in \operatorname {seg}^0(p)$ on which $\exp _p$ is injective. For $v_i\to v$, select $w_i\in \operatorname {seg}(p)$ with $\exp _pv_i=\exp _pw_i$. Any limit $w\ne v$ contradicts subsection 7.3; hence $w_i\to v$ and local injectivity gives $w_i=v_i$. The same dichotomy, together with nonsingularity on $V$, excludes $v_i$ from the star boundary. Thus $v_i\in \operatorname {seg}^0(p)$.

□
